component.name: frost
component.summary: Fast, GPU-rendered Linux terminal emulator built with Rust and iced

description.p: frost draws its terminal grid with iced on top of wgpu, including its own title bar so window decorations render with the same font fallback chain as the rest of the interface.

ul.li: Tabs and split panes over a shared PTY session model
Configurable themes, fonts, and UI scale, with CJK fallback fonts
A companion jsh shell that the palette can install or update
